about: The projects that run the hive, whose public state « hive.py health » reads (docs/cutter.md, "Feedback from projects to the hive"): their repositories on GitHub, as owner/name, each once. health reads each one's default branch (its settings and tasks) and its branch hive-state (its ledger), with no account, and sends nothing. A project is added or removed by a change of this file, as any change of this repository.
